declined_list_rows_checked: favourite-and-hold (the rule is a gap rule, not a favourite rule)
uniqueness.difference: the ladder-implied chance of a DIFFERENT strike (the 15 minute market's own), by interpolation, scored on the 15 minute result; no outside price

extracts: quote-data checkout: quotes/<date>/<HHMM>/ladder.csv.gz, quotes.csv.gz, results.csv.gz for date directories 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-01
data.independence_note: Oct 29 to Nov 1 are the development days of BOOKIMB1, FLOWHR1, MAKERMID1, MAKERTAIL1, ENTRYREPLAY1 block D and CFRTI-B: not independent of theirs

split.release_rule: outcome read only for closes after the last of the cards' reads or after 2026-12-15T23:59Z, whichever is earlier; count-only logging from Nov 16 allowed

event.entry_rule: buy YES at the 15 minute ask if gap > 0, else NO at 1 - the YES bid; one per hourly close

prediction: at least 100 events with |gap| >= 0.04, cash PF at 2c of 1.3 or more with each half above 1.0
kill: under 100 usable events, or 2c PF under 1.0 in either half

outputs.survivor_line: market, rule, PF 1c and 2c, n, days

holds.label: BOOKIMB1, FLOWHR1, MAKERMID1, MAKERTAIL1 holdout (KXBTCD)
holds.status: OPEN (never touched; this spec's window ends before it)

holds.label: their forward windows (KXBTCD closes)
holds.status: OPEN until their reads (read once at 150 trades or 2026-12-15)

holds.label: development days of BOOKIMB1, FLOWHR1, MAKERMID1, MAKERTAIL1, ENTRYREPLAY1 block D, CFRTI-B dev
holds.status: spent as development: this spec's days are NOT independent of theirs

look_ahead.decision_instant: D = H - 100 s (epoch ms D x 1000)
look_ahead.ladder_inputs: the last row of each strike with t_recv_ms <= D x 1000 and at most 6000 ms older; nothing after D
look_ahead.entry_quote: the 15 minute market's last row at or before D (its ask, or 1 - its bid), at most 6000 ms old
look_ahead.exit_price: settlement result read only after the cut check; no later quote

names: quote-data recorder files (Kalshi public GETs recorded by record-quotes.yml)

subset_rationale: a single rule registered before any value was read; no figure from these days was seen when it was written
halves: by order of the hourly close: the first floor(n/2) trades and the rest
fee_form: ceil(round(100 x 0.07 x c x p x (1 - p), 9)) / 100 per order; a void refunds the price and keeps the fee
